correctness.rationale: The quadratic change of variables gives the indicated positive definite Hessian (there is a harmless typesetting slip at the control quadratic term of the proof). Every mode has scalar curvature f_delta(a)=(1+alpha a²)/(a+delta)². Its derivative has sign alpha delta a−1, so the extreme modes can be realized by the two spectral endpoints and the clipped interior minimum, in a three-dimensional diagonal witness. With theta=arctan(sqrt(alpha)a) and phi=arctan(sqrt(alpha)delta), the condition number of the robust envelope is the ratio of max to min of sin² on a translated interval of length Delta. Moving an interval on one side of pi/2 toward the peak strictly lowers that ratio by strict cotangent monotonicity; on a straddling interval the smaller endpoint sine strictly increases toward the unique centered placement and then decreases. The centered placement is feasible for every specified interval including mu=0. This proves the unique optimum, its sec² value, and that the interior witness mode lies strictly between the endpoints. Endpoint modes alone have condition number one. The mu=0 and unit-parameter special cases follow by the half-angle identity and direct evaluation of the matched shift. The frozen finite checks were inspected, not rerun, and are not needed for these universal statements.
